Migrate environment variable handling to pydantic-settings
userStories.description: As a developer integrating BadDocs, I want all environment variable access centralised in a single validated Settings class so that misconfiguration is caught at startup with clear error messages rather than silently producing wrong behaviour at runtime. The .env.schema file is the canonical documentation of every setting and doubles as the varlock validation schema.
acceptanceCriteria: pydantic-settings>=2.0 is added to pyproject.toml [project] dependencies
src/baddocs/config/settings.py is created containing a Settings(BaseSettings) class that declares every variable currently read via os.getenv() anywhere in src/baddocs/

API key fields (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, QWEN_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY, GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET, DATABASE_PASSWORD) use pydantic SecretStr type so they are never exposed in repr() or logs
Numeric fields (PORT, BADDOCS_MONTHLY_BUDGET, GITHUB_APP_ID, DATABASE_PORT) use int or float types with appropriate validators
Boolean fields (BADDOCS_TRACK_COSTS, BADDOCS_AUTO_DOWNGRADE, MCP_ENABLED) use bool type
Enum fields (BADDOCS_MVP_TIER, BADDOCS_ROUTING_MODE, BADDOCS_LOG_LEVEL, ENVIRONMENT, DATABASE_TYPE) use Python Enum or Literal types
A module-level singleton `settings = Settings()` is exported from src/baddocs/config/settings.py
All os.getenv() and os.environ[] calls in src/baddocs/ are replaced with settings.<field> — grep -r 'os\.getenv\|os\.environ' src/baddocs/ returns 0 results
load_dotenv() calls are removed from all files except tests that explicitly test env loading
.env.schema at project root is kept in sync with the Settings class fields — every field in Settings has a matching entry in .env.schema

A new test file tests/unit/test_settings.py is created covering: (a) default values are correct, (b) SecretStr fields are not exposed in str(settings), (c) invalid BADDOCS_MVP_TIER raises ValidationError, (d) settings loads correctly from a temp .env file
All existing tests still pass after migration (pytest tests/ exits 0)
varlock run -- pytest tests/ passes when varlock is installed (document this command in DEVELOPMENT_WORKFLOW.md)
userStories.notes: Run on the dev branch only. Do not merge prd.json or scripts/ralph/ to main — see .gitattributes. After migration, remove the os.getenv usage from this notes field once grep confirms 0 results.
